subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BAKED’ is coded as ‘02-01-11-05-04’ and ‘MORE’ is coded as ‘13-15-18-05’. How is ‘EXTRA’ coded in the given language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fb1395d1b07e99e7820d5a595732c03b7af9e7177443f5d8808e0d5f66b0378.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 ‘BAKED’ is coded as ‘02-01-11-05-04’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72796be55a54f9ac90555b585be4c6334b3249e7f937a02e1c029881654f0c62.png] 

‘MORE’ is coded as ‘13-15-18-05’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a21bcf8dde2bac08f15fbab74d65b8fe5f833f5f576ff9cc8c4bf20729b0a7b.png] 

Similarly,

 ‘EXTRA’ is coded as ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bce24586f618f0d0e99a255a66b2344beb2e67223d8565e2055789433e4e4259.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 4".**
